podcasts.title: Scott Wu on Cybersecurity, Compute, and the Future of Engineering - [Invest Like the Best, EP.502]
podcasts.description: Scott Wu is the CEO and co-founder of Cognition, the company behind the AI coding agent Devin. Cognition made its first dollar of revenue in September 2024. Less than two years later, it crossed a $1 billion run rate, and Citi is rolling Devin out to about 14,000 engineers as it brings software projects in-house.
